shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Auto-launch via Launch button; feeds the TOP of the right orbit over the Bonus X lanes. Home of the skill shot. Hold LEFT flipper on launch to route down the left orbit for the Super Skill Shot.

shots.name: Left Orbit (Capture)
shots.notes: Capture TA lamps. MB jackpot, combo shot, and the Super Skill Shot return route. Loops fully when its award set is complete and gate is open.

shots.name: Left Ramp (Big-O-Beam)
shots.notes: Big-O-Beam TA lamps. Returns to left flipper. Combo/MB jackpot shot; cow easter-egg trigger.

shots.name: Center / Lock Ramp
shots.notes: Ramp normally; diverter drops the ball into the lock hole when Lock is lit. Does huge work: Multiball lock, TA Annihilation Super Jackpot, MB jackpot, combo shot. Located immediately LEFT of the saucer.

shots.name: Right Ramp (Tractor Beam)
shots.notes: Tractor Beam TA lamps. Smallest ramp; returns to right flipper. Combo/MB jackpot shot; cow easter-egg trigger.

shots.name: Right Orbit (Atomic Blaster)
shots.notes: Atomic Blaster TA lamps. The safest repeatable shot in the game (backhand from the right flipper) — used to farm TA jackpots and time roving supers. Autoplunger feeds the top of this orbit.

shots.name: Motor Bank / Force Field
shots.notes: Motorized 3-target bank guarding the saucer. Knock all three down to lower it and expose the saucer. Also the Strobe Multiball bash target (50M/hit). #1 SDTM drain hazard — hit same-side target from matching flipper.

shots.name: Saucer Drop Target
shots.notes: Rear drop target (with flanking standups) exposed once the force field is down. Repeated hits drain the saucer's health meter during Attack Waves.

shots.name: Mars Saucer Hole
shots.notes: Sinkhole behind the drop target. Destroys a saucer when its meter is empty; Conquer Mars = 10 hits at 100M, 10th destroys Mars for 2.5B. Also where TA hurry-ups sit. Popper-ejected.

shots.name: Stroke of Luck Scoop
shots.notes: Right of the saucer, below the jets. Collects Stroke of Luck, starts Martian Attack, lights Extra Ball, and starts Rule the Universe. Fed from the flipper or as a back shot out of the jets.

shots.name: Jet Bumpers
shots.notes: Three pop bumpers, upper center-right. 100 hits lights Super Jets (3M/hit); re-qualify at 125, 150. Exit down into the Stroke of Luck scoop or out the right orbit.

shots.name: Bonus X Top Lanes
shots.notes: Two rollover lanes at the very top, fed by either orbit. Advance the bonus multiplier (caps 250X) and award the standard skill shot. Steer with the flippers.

shots.name: M-A-R Martian Targets
shots.notes: Left 3-bank of green Martian standups. Part of spelling M-A-R-T-I-A-N to light Martian Attack; also a Martian to kill during Martian Attack/Multiball.

shots.name: A-N Martian Targets
shots.notes: Right 2-bank of green Martian standups; completes the M-A-R-T-I-A-N set.

shots.name: Martian 'T' Target
shots.notes: Single Martian standup low-center, left of the saucer. Drain-prone — bank off the opposite Martian rather than hitting head-on.

shots.name: Martian 'I' Target
shots.notes: Single Martian standup right of the force field, just left of the scoop. The other risky center Martian; bank off the opposite target.

shots.name: Inlane / Outlane Rollovers
shots.notes: The steerable inlane/outlane rollover set. Completing all lit positions lights Stroke of Luck at the scoop; 10 completions (14 on 5-ball) lights an Extra Ball.

shots.name: Launch Button
shots.notes: Cabinet button; auto-launches the ball. Also detonates a Martian Bomb (kills a random Martian) and clears the screen once per game.

goals.title: Regular Skill Shot
goals.summary: Plunge with no button held and steer the flashing top lane onto the ball for points and a bonus-multiplier boost.

steps.action: Plunge with no flipper held and steer the flashing lane onto the ball
steps.detail: Press Launch straight so the ball feeds the top rollover lanes, then use the flipper buttons to move the lit lane onto the ball's path — safe way to bank +5X every ball

goals.title: Super Skill Shot
goals.summary: Hold the left flipper on launch to route the ball down the left orbit and back to the flippers untouched, then hit the left ramp, the right ramp or either orbit for 50M and all three of that shot's Total Annihilation lamps — a force-field target also pays 50M and lowers the force field. The center lock ramp, the saucer hole and the Stroke of Luck scoop pay nothing here.

steps.action: Plunge through, then immediately shoot the right ramp or an orbit
steps.detail: Sends the ball down the left orbit and back to the flippers untouched, arming a ~2 second window 50M and instantly completes that shot's award — e.g. right ramp finishes all three Tractor Beam TA lamps in one hit

goals.title: 5-Way Combo
goals.summary: Chain five consecutive ramp/orbit shots before the combo timer expires. One of the six Rule the Universe objectives.

steps.action: Shoot a ramp to start the combo
steps.detail: Any ramp lights the red combo arrows on the other shots

steps.action: Shoot the next lit arrow
steps.detail: Hit before the fixed combo timer runs out; unrelated targets don't extend it

steps.action: Continue the chain
Continue — an orbit only counts if its TA lamps are complete, gate open, and Super Jets is off
Fifth shot completes the 5-Way Combo
steps.detail: Trivial when you just combo the ramps

goals.title: Total Annihilation Jackpot Farm
goals.summary: Inside Total Annihilation all shots stay lit — pump the safest shot, then cash the center-ramp super. The game's #1 money loop.

steps.action: Backhand the right orbit repeatedly
steps.detail: Safest repeat shot; jackpots start ~50M and grow +5M, and every shot stays lit

steps.action: Keep pumping the same shot to build the pool
Cash the Annihilation Super Jackpot
steps.detail: Center/lock ramp pays the Annihilation Jackpot, which climbs with every jackpot you collect and caps at 200M, then drops back to its base value once cashed — repeat the loop

goals.summary: Collect all five lit jackpots in regular Multiball to light a traveling Super Jackpot, then fire when it lands on your best shot.

steps.action: Collect the lit jackpots on the five major shots
steps.detail: Both ramps, both orbits and the center ramp start at 60M, +10M each

steps.action: Mop up the remaining jackpots
Watch the roving Super Jackpot travel

steps.action: Trap up and fire when the super light lands on the right orbit
steps.detail: Your most reliable shot; collecting resets the cycle

goals.title: Post-Conquer-Mars Saucer Farm
goals.summary: Once Mars is conquered every saucer-hole hit pays a flat 100M — a safe, repeatable center shot for late-game padding.
goals.reward: 100M per hit, repeatable rest of game

steps.action: Shoot the open Mars saucer hole

steps.action: Lock three balls at the center ramp
steps.detail: The diverter drops each shot into the lock hole

steps.action: Shoot each of the four TA shots three times

goals.summary: Win Strobe Multiball from Stroke of Luck, then bash the force field in the dark for 50M a hit.

steps.action: Complete the inlane/outlane rollovers to light Stroke of Luck
steps.detail: Steer the lit positions with the flipper buttons

drills.title: Super Skill Fan
drills.text: Hold the left flipper on the launch so the ball runs down the left orbit and back to the flippers untouched, then take a ramp or an orbit before the window closes. Pick a different one of the four Total Annihilation lanes each plunge — the hit completes all three of that lane's lamps in one go.

drills.title: Same-Side Force Field
drills.text: Trap first, then take the right force-field target from the right flipper and the left one from the left. Reaching across the bank is what turns a miss into a straight-down-the-middle rebound, and this is the most common way to lose a ball here.

drills.title: Right Orbit Backhand Farm
drills.text: Backhand the right orbit from a cradled right flipper over and over, then break off and cash the center ramp. It is the lowest-risk repeat shot on the machine and the whole Total Annihilation farm runs through it, so build the reflex before you need it.

drills.title: Wait for the Super
drills.text: In multiball, trap a ball and hold it while the roving Super Jackpot cycles left to right. Let it come to the right orbit instead of chasing it across the playfield — the cycle has no timer, so the only thing that costs you is impatience.

drills.title: Five-Ramp Chain
drills.text: Chain five shots inside the combo timer using the ramps only — left ramp, center, right ramp, and back again. Orbits only continue a chain when their lamps are complete and the gate is open, so keep them out of it until the ramps are automatic.

drills.title: Bank the Martians
drills.text: Sweep the two Martian banks first, then take the T and I singles by banking off the opposite target rather than aiming head-on. Both of those center standups reject straight down when you hit them square.

actionButton.label: Launch Button
actionButton.location: front right of the cabinet, in the spot a shooter rod would normally occupy — this game auto-plunges
actionButton.how: No lockdown-bar button here; this is 1995. What AFM has instead is a Launch button that pulls double duty. Past firing the auto-plunger, it detonates a Martian Bomb during the attack phase and drops a smart bomb in video mode, and it flashes whenever a bomb is loaded.

uses.when: Martians flashing and the button flashing
uses.what: Detonates a Martian Bomb and kills one of the remaining Martians outright, no shot required.

uses.when: One stubborn Martian left, ball just drained
uses.what: You can still bomb it after an outlane drain — it counts right up until the ball reaches the trough.

uses.when: A saucer is about to touch down
uses.what: Once per video mode, wipes every saucer off the screen. It has nothing to do with your Martian Bombs.

uses.when: A cow shows up after a ramp shot
uses.what: Tap it repeatedly for moos; do that on both the Big-O-Beam and Tractor Beam ramps to unlock Cow video mode.

uses.when: Starting a ball for the skill shot
uses.what: Press with no flipper held to feed the top lanes; hold the left flipper first to route around for the Super Skill Shot.

howItPlays.objective: Destroy the Martian saucers and conquer Mars, then stack multiballs and Total Annihilation to reach the Rule the Universe wizard mode.
loop: Knock down the force field to expose the saucer drop target.
Damage the saucer via the drop target, then shoot the saucer hole to destroy it.
Destroy all five cities to open Mars, then hit Mars ten times for 2.5 billion.
Start an Attack Wave before multiball so saucer destruction stacks under jackpots.
Complete Total Annihilation lamps on all four shots to start the 4-ball multiball and farm jackpots.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Either flipper button after launch steers the flashing top lane onto the ball's path.

scoring.text: Bank the regular skill shot for +5X bonus multiplier and points, and use the Super Skill Shot for 50M and an instant award spot on a major shot.
Stack multiballs with Total Annihilation: lock three balls for Multiball, complete TA lamps for the 4-ball mode, and build the bonus multiplier via top lanes and skill shots.
Complete all six Rule the Universe objectives, then start the wizard mode at the scoop and score 5 billion to win a flat +5B.
